package main

// #include "utils.h"
import "C"

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"unsafe"

	"github.com/apache/arrow-adbc/go/adbc"
)

func checkBridge(t *testing.T) {
	const message = "literal 100% complete: %s %d %!"
	for _, prefixed := range []bool{false, true} {
		input := message
		if prefixed {
			input = errPrefix + input
		}
		for _, kind := range []string{"ordinary", "no-details", "vendor-code", "details"} {
			t.Run(kind+"/"+input, func(t *testing.T) {
				var out C.struct_AdbcError
				defer C.TesterrRelease(&out)
				if kind != "details" {
					setErr(&out, "replace this previous error")
				}
				expected := errPrefix + message
				var original error = errors.New(input)
				status := adbc.StatusUnknown
				if kind != "ordinary" {
					typed := adbc.Error{Code: adbc.StatusInvalidData, Msg: input, SqlState: [5]byte{'2', '2', '0', '0', '0'}}
					if kind == "vendor-code" {
						out.vendor_code = C.ADBC_ERROR_VENDOR_CODE_PRIVATE_DATA
						typed.VendorCode = 27
					}
					if kind == "details" {
						// The details branch preserves the supplied text verbatim, including
						// whether its producer chose to add the driver prefix.
						expected = input
						out.vendor_code = C.ADBC_ERROR_VENDOR_CODE_PRIVATE_DATA
						typed.Details = []adbc.ErrorDetail{&adbc.BinaryErrorDetail{Name: "bytes", Detail: []byte{0, 255, 37}}}
					}
					original = typed
					status = adbc.StatusInvalidData
				}
				if got := errToAdbcErr(&out, original); got != status {
					t.Fatalf("status: %v", got)
				}
				if got := C.GoString(out.message); got != expected {
					t.Fatalf("text: %q, expected %q", got, expected)
				}
				if kind != "ordinary" && string(C.GoBytes(unsafe.Pointer(&out.sqlstate[0]), 5)) != "22000" {
					t.Fatal("lost SQLSTATE")
				}
				if kind == "vendor-code" && out.vendor_code != 27 {
					t.Fatal("lost vendor code")
				}
				if kind == "details" {
					if got := C.TestErrorGetDetailCount(&out); got != 1 {
						t.Fatalf("detail count: %d", got)
					}
					detail := C.TestErrorGetDetail(&out, 0)
					if C.GoString(detail.key) != "bytes" || !bytes.Equal(C.GoBytes(unsafe.Pointer(detail.value), C.int(detail.value_length)), []byte{0, 255, 37}) {
						t.Fatal("lost binary detail")
					}
					setErr(&out, message)
					if out.private_data != nil {
						t.Fatal("old detail owner was not released on replacement")
					}
					if C.TestErrorGetDetailCount(&out) != 0 {
						t.Fatal("old details survived replacement")
					}
					if C.GoString(out.message) != errPrefix+message {
						t.Fatal("replacement text changed")
					}
				}
				C.TesterrRelease(&out)
				if out.release != nil || out.message != nil || out.private_data != nil {
					t.Fatal("release did not clear owner")
				}
				C.TesterrRelease(&out) // Released errors are harmless to release again.
			})
		}
	}
	var out C.struct_AdbcError
	fmtErr(&out, "formatted %s %d", "value", 27)
	if C.GoString(out.message) != errPrefix+"formatted value 27" {
		t.Fatal("formatted errors stopped formatting")
	}
	C.TesterrRelease(&out)
	setErr(nil, message)
	fmtErr(nil, "%s", message)
	setErrWithDetails(nil, adbc.Error{Msg: message})
	if got := errToAdbcErr(nil, errors.New(message)); got != adbc.StatusUnknown {
		t.Fatal("nil output changed status")
	}
	if got := errToAdbcErr(nil, nil); got != adbc.StatusOK {
		t.Fatal("nil error changed status")
	}
}
